## Description

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Checkable statements, not tasks. "A recipe reaches the table with
      `owner_sub` from the session" rather than "write the insert"
- [ ] Include the unhappy paths: the empty case, the unauthorized case, the
      one where the upstream fails
- [ ] If a decision has to be made before code, make the decision itself a
      criterion
